advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm the branch-existence TOCTOU between _ls_remote and clone cannot cause a non-fast-forward push failure under concurrent commit activities.
evidence: 131: clone_ref = request.branch if branch_exists else request.base
advisory.finding: The branch-existence check (`_ls_remote`) is now evaluated before the clone and its result reused to choose `clone_ref` and drive `checkout -b`, opening a time-of-check/time-of-use window: if the branch is created remotely between the `_ls_remote` call and the clone, `clone_ref` stays `request.base`, the code takes the not-exists path (`checkout -b request.branch`), and the final `push origin request.branch` will hit a non-fast-forward failure that raises. The prior code re-checked branch existence within the same clone flow and checked out the existing branch.
scenarios: Two concurrent commit_and_push activities for the same branch, or a branch created by another actor between the ls-remote probe and the clone.

blocking.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that commits onto an already-existing branch and asserts the clone uses `--branch <existing-branch>` (branch-exists path).
evidence: adapters/real/git_host.py:130-131 `branch_exists = bool(await self._ls_remote(remote, request.branch))` / `clone_ref = request.branch if branch_exists else request.base`
adapters/real/git_host.py:144-145 `if not branch_exists:` / `await self._git("checkout", "-b", request.branch, cwd=work)`

test asserts only the base path: tests/integration/test_github_real_backend.py:178 `assert clones[0][clones[0].index("--branch") + 1] == "main"` — branch (agent_branch_name(TASK_ID)) does not pre-exist, so clone_ref resolves to base=main

ABSENCE: no test creates the branch first and then asserts commit_and_push clones with `--branch <existing-branch>`; the idempotent test (line 126) reaches the branch-exists path but asserts only replayed/pushed flags, not the clone ref (named violating input: a second commit onto branch agent_branch_name(TASK_ID) after it exists)
blocking.finding: The new test only covers the branch-does-not-exist clone path (clone_ref=base). The changed branch-exists path — clone_ref=request.branch with the checkout -b skipped — is a newly added behavior with no test asserting the clone uses --branch <branch>; a regression cloning the base ref instead of the existing branch on that path would go undetected.
scenarios: A commit onto an already-existing agent branch clones the wrong ref (e.g. base instead of the branch) without failing any test
blocking.suggested_fix: Add a test that first calls ensure_branch/commit to create the branch, then records clones on a second commit_and_push and asserts clones[0][index('--branch')+1] == agent_branch_name(TASK_ID).
